usedFor: Slack holds members and Demio runs webinars, so “New User Joined or Updated in Your Org” runs “Register Attendee”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Joined or Updated in Your Org” in Slack, then “Register Attendee” in Demio

watchOut: That trigger name covers updates as well as joins, so check the same person is not registered twice.
